raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Specialized decode for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on B200 and B300 (RFC #60904). It's off by default; `--additional-config '{"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}'` turns it on.

I'm building the whole decode step in this PR. What's here now is the FFN half at 1-8 rows: persistent CuTe DSL kernels chained with PDL, instead of the stock chain of 11 launches. The attention, the all-reduce and the `plan()` executor come next, on this branch. Prefill and larger batches stay stock. All numbers below are for the FFN half.

## Claims

- FFN half per layer, one GPU, CUDA graph replay, real weights and real router inputs: 1.62x geomean on B200 and 1.63x on B300 over 1-8 rows (B300: 30.4 -> 17.4 us at 1 row, 39.4 -> 26.1 us at 8 rows).
- Real model, `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`, 4x B200, TP=4: TPOT -21% at C1 (4.97 -> 3.91 ms), -21% at C2, -23% at C4, -19% at C8.
- No measurable accuracy change on GSM8K, GPQA-Diamond or AIME 2024 at concurrency 8.
- With the setting off, none of the new kernels are built or run.

## Validation

Component, one GPU. 12 layers in a CUDA graph with layer 3's real weights cut into the four TP4 ranks' slices, 48 windows of real consecutive MoE input rows, 7 trials of 200 replays. The stock side is the same layer on `forward_unfinalized`, autotuned, sharing the weights.

| rows | B200 stock -> FFN us | B200 speedup | B300 stock -> FFN us | B300 speedup | byte bound us (B300) |
|---:|---|---:|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | 31.2 -> 18.1 | 1.73x | 30.4 -> 17.4 | 1.75x | 6.5 |
| 2 | 33.3 -> 19.3 | 1.73x | 31.9 -> 18.6 | 1.72x | |
| 4 | 36.2 -> 22.4 | 1.61x | 35.4 -> 21.8 | 1.63x | |
| 8 | 40.5 -> 26.7 | 1.52x | 39.4 -> 26.1 | 1.51x | 15.3 |

The bound is weight bytes over about 7.65 TB/s of HBM. Noise between trials is 1.5%. Run on this head.

Numerics: each case also runs real, scattered, hot, distinct-expert, production-like and extreme inputs (zero rows, 1e-30, x64, spikes), replayed from the CUDA graph with new values and checked against a float64 reference of the stock chain, including its rounding, with per-element, projection and per-tile bounds calibrated on stock. The FFN stays inside them, and its max error is within 0.03% of stock's in all 192 checks. Outputs aren't bitwise equal to stock, because the shared FC1 sums over K in a different order.

Full model A/B. 4x B200, TP=4, official checkpoint, one container, server starts on / off / on / off, the two sides differ only in the setting. It ran on this branch one commit back (the last commit only adds a comment and CI paths), on the nightly it is merged with:

```
vllm serve MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash --tensor-parallel-size 4 --language-model-only --block-size 128 --disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager \
  --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4 --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "nvfp4", "use_prefill_query_quantization": true}' \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 64 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --additional-config '{"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}'   # on only
vllm bench serve --dataset-name random --random-input-len 2048 --random-output-len 256 --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --temperature 0 \
  --num-prompts 8|16|32|48 --max-concurrency 1|2|4|8
```

| conc | median TPOT ms (off -> on) | range off | range on | output tok/s (off -> on) |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4.97 -> 3.91 (-21.4%) | 4.85-5.08 | 3.84-3.97 | 183 -> 228 |
| 2 | 5.53 -> 4.38 (-20.7%) | 5.40-5.65 | 4.29-4.48 | 317 -> 387 |
| 4 | 6.17 -> 4.74 (-23.2%) | 6.07-6.28 | 4.67-4.81 | 555 -> 698 |
| 8 | 6.95 -> 5.61 (-19.3%) | 6.81-7.08 | 5.52-5.69 | 985 -> 1179 |

Two runs per server start, two starts per side. The second start of each side was 3-5% slower, so the sides are interleaved. 7168-token TTFT is the same (on 153 ms, off 152-159 ms).

The step saves 1.1-1.4 ms, more than the component table times 56 layers (about 0.75 ms). The table's rows are consecutive rows of one request (12.5 experts at 8 rows). Rows from different real requests touch more (16.4 at 8 rows, layer 3), and I didn't measure routing for the bench's random prompts. I haven't isolated the gap.

Accuracy, same setup, concurrency 8, greedy, seed 42:

| eval | on | off | right on one side only (off / on) | exact McNemar p |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| GSM8K, chat | 1140 of 1192 | 1146 of 1192 | 12 / 6 | 0.24 |
| GPQA-Diamond, 4096 tokens | 131 of 198 | 125 of 198 | 17 / 23 | 0.43 |
| AIME 2024, 8192 tokens | 22 of 30 | 23 of 30 | 3 / 2 | 1.0 |

The GSM8K row is the questions both sides finished: off hit my 420 s limit at 1192, on finished all 1319 with 1263 right. On GPQA most misses are answers cut off at 4096 tokens (56 on, 61 off); answered questions are 92% right on both sides. On AIME all answered questions are right, the rest ran out of tokens.

5-shot completions GSM8K gets about 8% on both sides on this model (104 on, 99 off of 1319), so it can't show anything here, and I used chat. I haven't looked into why it's that low on the stock path.

Tests on this head, 1x B200:

```
pytest -v -s tests/models/minimax_m3 --ignore=tests/models/minimax_m3/amd_specialized_decode   # 62 passed, 4 skipped
```

The skips are the existing `flydsl` and AMD-only ones. Same result with this branch's Python merged on main at 37753d9dd, on the same nightly image.

The new `test_kernels.py` runs the FFN against the stock call at 1, 3 and 8 rows, on random, one-expert-set and distinct-expert inputs, eagerly and replayed from a CUDA graph.

compute-sanitizer 2026.3 on 1x B200, the new kernels alone, same 18 cases: memcheck reports no device errors and synccheck 0 errors. racecheck doesn't get through setup in the test container (the process dies or stalls while the kernels are built, with or without a stock-only test body), so I have no racecheck result.

## Details

Why launches: at 1 row stock runs 11 kernels per layer, half of them near the 4 us floor of a separate launch, and DRAM stays under 25% of peak (ncu, B300). At 8 consecutive rows only 12.5 experts are touched, so bytes aren't the limit either.

What runs now, 9 kernels:
- Main stream: the stock gate; a front (top-4, routing weights, per-token NVFP4 of the input, routing record); routed FC1 with SwiGLU-OAI in the epilogue; FC2's per-token input quantization; routed FC2.
- Aux stream, as stock: MXFP8 input; shared FC1 split over K into 144 work items (stock has 12 CTAs at 9% warps active); activation + MXFP8; shared FC2.
- The `MoEOutput` goes to the existing fused boundary kernel unchanged.

Under ncu, which runs kernels one at a time with a cold L2, the serial sum only moves 69.6 -> 59.4 us at 1 row, and the GEMMs read at the same 25% of peak as stock (65% at 8 uniform rows). So most of the gain is overlap and launch count, which only shows in graph replay. Routed FC2 on 4 pipeline stages instead of 8 gives 6% at 1 row with bitwise equal output, and I don't have the mechanism for that one.

Where it runs: FULL CUDA graph captures of pure decode steps of 1-8 rows, on the MoE layers that defer their finalize (56 of 57; the last one stays stock). Eager forwards, PIECEWISE captures, prefill and larger batches run the stock code. At startup, `decode_backend=latency_specialized` raises with every missing requirement: SM100 family, MRV2, M3.1-Flash's shapes at TP=4, FULL decode graphs, TP only (no PP, DP, EP or context parallelism), no torch.compile, sleep mode, LoRA or batch invariance, and the fused boundary with NVLink multicast. `specialized_decode/AGENTS.md` has the scope and paths, like #61868, and that's the only doc for now. I'd add the M3.1 recipe entry once the setting has been reviewed, tell me if you'd rather have it in this PR.

Reuse: the routing record and persistent GEMM skeleton are imported from `deepseek_v41/nvidia/specialized_decode/moe/`, and the CI step's dependencies now list that directory. Size: 1,297 lines of kernels, 588 of host code, 125 of config, 44 in `model.py`, 290 of tests.

Not measured: C16 and up (stock path), DSpark, the full model on B300, and off against main (off adds one attribute check per `forward_unfinalized`).

#65433 and #65434 extend the boundary kernel past 32 tokens and don't touch the FFN half; whichever lands second has a small merge in `_init_fused_moe_finalize`. No open PR adds a specialized decode for M3.1 on NVIDIA. #62712 and #63398 are the MI355X ones.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used. I reviewed the change and ran the tests above.

@@ -0,0 +1,290 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The MiniMax-M3 low-batch FFN (``specialized_decode/moe``) against the stock
+code it replaces, on random weights in the checkpoint's formats (NVFP4 routed
+experts, compressed-tensors; MXFP8 shared expert; FP32 router): the stock
+TRT-LLM-gen experts' call stopped after GEMM2 and the stock shared MLP."""
+
+import os
+import tempfile
+from contextlib import suppress
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from transformers import PretrainedConfig
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (
+        current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+    ),
+    reason="the low-batch FFN kernels run on SM100-family GPUs",
+)
+
+HIDDEN, EXPERTS, INTERMEDIATE, TOP_K = 6144, 128, 768, 4
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def layer():
+    """One stock ``MiniMaxM3MoE`` with processed random weights, its config
+    and its low-batch FFN."""
+    from vllm.config import (
+        KernelConfig,
+        ParallelConfig,
+        VllmConfig,
+        set_current_vllm_config,
+    )
+    from vllm.distributed import (
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory,
+        init_distributed_environment,
+        initialize_model_parallel,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.base_config import (
+        QuantizeMethodBase,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import ModelOptMxFp8Config
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.model import MiniMaxM3MoE
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.specialized_decode.moe import (
+        build_low_batch_ffn,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import init_workspace_manager
+
+    quant = ModelOptMxFp8Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "mxfp8",
+            "weight_block_size": [1, 32],
+            "activation_scheme": "dynamic",
+            "moe_quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+            "moe_quant_format": "nvfp4-pack-quantized",
+            "group_size": 16,
+            "ignored_layers": [],
+        }
+    )
+    hf = PretrainedConfig(
+        hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+        num_local_experts=EXPERTS,
+        num_experts_per_tok=TOP_K,
+        intermediate_size=INTERMEDIATE,
+        scoring_func="sigmoid",
+        hidden_act="swigluoai",
+        swiglu_limit=7.0,
+        swiglu_alpha=1.702,
+        swiglu_beta=1.0,
+        use_routing_bias=True,
+        routed_scaling_factor=2.0,
+        n_shared_experts=1,
+        num_hidden_layers=1,
+    )
+    config = VllmConfig(parallel_config=ParallelConfig(), kernel_config=KernelConfig())
+    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
+    os.close(fd)
+    default_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
+    try:
+        with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+            init_distributed_environment(
+                world_size=1,
+                rank=0,
+                distributed_init_method=f"file://{path}",
+                local_rank=0,
+                backend="nccl",
+            )
+            initialize_model_parallel(1, 1)
+            init_workspace_manager(torch.device(DEVICE))
+            torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)
+            moe = MiniMaxM3MoE(
+                hf, 3, quant_config=quant, reduce_results=False, prefix="layers.3.moe"
+            ).to(DEVICE)
+            torch.set_default_dtype(default_dtype)
+            _fill(moe, torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(0))
+            for module in moe.modules():
+                method = getattr(module, "quant_method", None)
+                if isinstance(method, QuantizeMethodBase):
+                    method.process_weights_after_loading(module)
+            ffn = build_low_batch_ffn(moe)
+            assert ffn is not None
+            yield moe, config, ffn
+    finally:
+        torch.set_default_dtype(default_dtype)
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+        with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
+            os.remove(path)
+
+
+def _fill(moe, generator):
+    """Random weights of a checkpoint's magnitudes."""
+
+    def randint(low, high, tensor):
+        tensor.copy_(
+            torch.randint(low, high, tensor.shape, generator=generator, device=DEVICE)
+            .to(torch.uint8)
+            .view(tensor.dtype)
+        )
+
+    routed = moe.experts.routed_experts
+    for name in ("w13", "w2"):
+        randint(0, 256, getattr(routed, f"{name}_weight_packed").data)
+        # E4M3 scales between 0.5 and 4.
+        randint(0x30, 0x48, getattr(routed, f"{name}_weight_scale").data)
+        getattr(routed, f"{name}_weight_global_scale").data.fill_(1.5e4)
+        getattr(routed, f"{name}_input_global_scale").data.fill_(1.0)
+    moe.gate.weight.data.normal_(0, 0.02, generator=generator)
+    moe.e_score_correction_bias.data.uniform_(0, 2, generator=generator)

+def _inputs(kind, rows, generator, moe):
+    """BF16 rows routed in one of three ways, and the router's bias and gate
+    weight to restore afterwards."""

+        moe.e_score_correction_bias.data[5:9] += 20

+        moe.e_score_correction_bias.data.zero_()

+        x[torch.arange(rows), torch.arange(rows)] = 1
+        gate = moe.gate.weight.data
+        gate.zero_()

+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+        convert_flashinfer_moe_output,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.utils import fi_moe_largest_bucket
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.flashinfer_utils import (
+        activation_to_flashinfer_int,
+        quantize_nvfp4_per_token_input,
+    )
+
+    routed = moe.experts.routed_experts
+    impl = routed.quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    quant = impl.quant_config
+    logits, _ = moe.gate(x)
+    values, scales, per_token = quantize_nvfp4_per_token_input(x)
+    result = trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe(
+        routing_logits=logits,
+        routing_bias=moe.e_score_correction_bias,
+        hidden_states=values,
+        hidden_states_scale=scales.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(x.shape[0], -1),
+        gemm1_weights=routed.w13_weight,
+        gemm1_weights_scale=quant.w1_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        gemm1_bias=None,
+        gemm1_alpha=impl.gemm1_alpha,
+        gemm1_beta=impl.gemm1_beta,
+        gemm1_clamp_limit=impl.gemm1_clamp_limit,
+        gemm2_weights=routed.w2_weight,
+        gemm2_weights_scale=quant.w2_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        gemm2_bias=None,
+        output1_scale_scalar=impl.g1_scale_c,
+        output1_scale_gate_scalar=quant.g1_alphas,
+        output2_scale_scalar=quant.g2_alphas,
+        num_experts=EXPERTS,
+        top_k=TOP_K,
+        n_group=0,
+        topk_group=0,
+        intermediate_size=INTERMEDIATE,
+        local_expert_offset=0,
+        local_num_experts=EXPERTS,
+        routed_scaling_factor=moe.routed_scaling_factor,
+        routing_method_type=impl.routing_method_type,
+        do_finalize=False,
+        activation_type=activation_to_flashinfer_int(impl.moe_config.activation),
+        per_token_scale=per_token,
+        tune_max_num_tokens=fi_moe_largest_bucket(impl.moe_config),
+    )
+    return convert_flashinfer_moe_output(
+        result, do_finalize=False, num_tokens=x.shape[0], top_k=TOP_K
+    )
+
+
+def _final(routed, shared):
+    """FP32 rows: the weighted routed rows plus the shared output."""
+    rows = routed.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.long()
+    picked = routed.gemm2_permuted[rows.view(-1)].float().view(*rows.shape, HIDDEN)
+    weights = routed.expert_weights.float().unsqueeze(-1)
+    return (picked * weights).sum(dim=1) + shared.float()
+
+
+def _check(out, moe, x):
+    """The same routing weights (to one BF16 ulp) and outputs within the
+    rounding of two NVFP4 / MXFP8 chains. They are mostly bitwise equal, but
+    the GEMMs accumulate in different orders, so a BF16 or E2M1 rounding can
+    flip, which moves a row by about a percent; a wrong expert, scale,
+    clamp or row moves it by far more."""

+        moe.gate.weight.data.copy_(gate)

+# MiniMax-M3 specialized decode (NVIDIA)
+
+Kernels for small decode batches of MiniMax-M3.1-Flash on B200 and B300,
+enabled with `--additional-config '{"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}'`
+(the default, `auto`, keeps the stock decode). With it off, the model runs
+exactly as without this package. Its first step covers the FFN half of the MoE
+layers; the attention, the all-reduce, the dense layers and the MTP draft keep
+their stock paths.
+
+## Scope
+
+`specialized_decode_config` (`__init__.py`) reads the setting once, when the
+model is built. Any deployment other than the one below raises at startup on
+every TP rank with the missing requirements:
+
+- GPU: SM100 family (B200, B300), one code path.
+- Runner: Model Runner V2.
+- Parallelism: tensor parallel only; no pipeline, data, expert or context
+  parallelism, no micro-batching.
+- Layers: hidden size 6144, 128 experts, top-4, 768 intermediate columns per
+  rank for the routed and the shared expert (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash at TP4), no
+  MegaMoE.
+- CUDA graphs: FULL graphs for decode batches only (`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` or
+  `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`).
+- No `torch.compile` of the model, no sleep mode, no LoRA or batch invariance.
+- The fused MoE finalize + all-reduce + norm (`ops/finalize_allreduce_norm.py`),
+  which needs NVLink multicast on every rank.
+
+Every rank gives the same answer: the other checks read only the configuration,
+and `supports_fused_moe_finalize` decides the multicast probe over the TP group
+(an all-ranks reduction), so either every rank raises or none does.
+
+Two more checks follow, and they also raise on every rank, because the
+configuration decides both:
+
+- When the model is built, at least one MoE layer must leave its top-k finalize
+  to the next layer's fused kernel. Only those layers get the low-batch FFN;
+  the last MoE layer finalizes itself and stays stock.
+- Once the weights are processed, each of those layers must be able to take
+  the FFN (`moe.unsupported_reason`):
+  - TRT-LLM-gen monolithic NVFP4 experts with per-token activations;
+  - a FlashInfer MXFP8 shared expert;
+  - the SwiGLU-OAI constants the kernels are compiled with.
+
+## Structure
+
+| Path | Contents |
+| --- | --- |
+| `__init__.py` | The setting, the startup checks, the per-call capture gate |
+| `moe/__init__.py` | `build_low_batch_ffn`, `LowBatchFfn` (`accepts`, `run`), `unsupported_reason` |
+| `moe/front_cute.py` | Routing + per-token NVFP4 input + routing record in one launch; FC2's input quantization |
+| `moe/gemm_cute.py` | Routed FC1 (SwiGLU-OAI epilogue) and FC2 on persistent `tcgen05` NVFP4 GEMMs |
+| `moe/shared_cute.py` | The MXFP8 shared expert: input quantization, split-K FC1, SwiGLU-OAI + MXFP8, FC2 on the same GEMM |
+
+The routing record and the persistent GEMM skeleton are imported from the
+DeepSeek-V4.1 low-batch MoE (`deepseek_v41/nvidia/specialized_decode/moe/`).
+`MiniMaxM3MoE.process_weights_after_loading` builds one `LowBatchFfn` per MoE
+layer once the weights are processed; it compiles the kernels then, outside any
+CUDA graph capture, and binds the routed and shared expert weights in place (no
+copies).
+
+## Paths
+
+| Path | Rows |
+| --- | --- |
+| Gate: stock `GateLinear` (FP32 logits) | all |
+| Front: top-4 of `sigmoid(logit) + bias`, BF16 weights from the recovered scores, per-token NVFP4 of the input, routing record | 1-8 |
+| Routed FC1 and FC2 on the record's work items, FC2's input quantized per token from FC1's BF16 output | 1-8 |
+| Shared expert on the aux stream, joined before `run` returns: MXFP8 input, FC1 split over K into 12 slices (144 work items), BF16 gate_up and SwiGLU-OAI to MXFP8 `h`, FC2 | 1-8 |
+| Top-k finalize, all-reduce, next input norm: the fused boundary kernel | up to 32 |
+
+## Dispatch
+
+`MiniMaxM3MoE.forward_unfinalized` runs the low-batch FFN only when it holds
+one (the layers above), `accepts(x)` (1-8 contiguous BF16 rows, the bound
+weights) and the forward is being captured into a FULL CUDA graph
+(`captures_pure_decode`); every eager forward, PIECEWISE capture, prefill and
+larger batch runs the stock code. The
+gate reads host state only, nothing is read back from the GPU, and it is the
+same on every TP rank.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""MiniMax-M3 specialized decode on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, enabled with
+``additional_config={"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}``.
+
+Its first step is the low-batch FFN half of the MoE layers (``moe/``): FULL
+CUDA graph captures of pure decode steps run it for batches of 1-8 rows;
+every other forward runs the stock layers.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.config import CompilationMode, CUDAGraphMode, VllmConfig
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# One TP4 rank of MiniMax-M3.1-Flash: what the low-batch FFN's kernels are
+# compiled for.
+HIDDEN = 6144
+EXPERTS = 128
+TOP_K = 4
+INTERMEDIATE_PER_RANK = 768
+
+
+def unsupported(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> list[str]:
+    """Every requirement of the specialized decode the configuration misses
+    (the fused MoE finalize is checked separately)."""
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.model import _use_mega_moe
+
+    parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    compilation = vllm_config.compilation_config
+    cudagraph_mode = compilation.cudagraph_mode
+    config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    tp = parallel.tensor_parallel_size
+    shared = getattr(config, "n_shared_experts", 0) or 0
+    requirements = {
+        "an SM100-family GPU (B200, B300)": current_platform.is_cuda()
+        and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+        "Model Runner V2": vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner,
+        "no pipeline, data, expert or context parallelism or micro-batching": (
+            parallel.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
+            and parallel.data_parallel_size == 1
+            and not parallel.enable_expert_parallel
+            and parallel.decode_context_parallel_size == 1
+            and parallel.prefill_context_parallel_size == 1
+            and not parallel.use_ubatching
+        ),
+        f"MoE layers of hidden size {HIDDEN}, {EXPERTS} experts, top-{TOP_K} and "
+        f"{INTERMEDIATE_PER_RANK} intermediate columns per rank for the routed "
+        "and the shared expert": (
+            config.hidden_size == HIDDEN
+            and config.num_local_experts == EXPERTS
+            and config.num_experts_per_tok == TOP_K
+            and config.intermediate_size == INTERMEDIATE_PER_RANK * tp
+            and shared == 1
+            and not _use_mega_moe(vllm_config)
+        ),
+        "FULL CUDA graphs for decode batches only (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE or "
+        "FULL_DECODE_ONLY)": (
+            cudagraph_mode is not None
+            and cudagraph_mode.decode_mode() == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            and cudagraph_mode.mixed_mode() != CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+        ),
+        "no torch.compile of the model": (
+            compilation.mode != CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE
+        ),
+        # The low-batch FFN binds weight addresses.
+        "no sleep mode": not vllm_config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode,
+        "no LoRA or batch invariance": (
+            vllm_config.lora_config is None and not envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT
+        ),
+    }
+    return [need for need, ok in requirements.items() if not ok]
+
+
+def captures_pure_decode() -> bool:
+    """Whether this forward is being captured into a FULL CUDA graph, which
+    under the decode-only FULL graphs required above is a pure decode step.
+    Model Runner V2 captures FULL graphs with the forward context's mode NONE
+    and PIECEWISE ones, which report capturing too, with PIECEWISE."""
+    return (
+        torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        and is_forward_context_available()
+        and get_forward_context().cudagraph_runtime_mode != CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
+    )
+
+
+def specialized_decode_config(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> bool:
+    """Whether the specialized decode is on (``decode_backend``).
+
+    Raises with every missing requirement when requested. The configuration
+    checks give the same answer on every TP rank, and the fused MoE finalize the
+    low-batch FFN feeds (NVLink multicast) is decided over the TP group inside
+    ``supports_fused_moe_finalize``, so every rank raises alike.
+    """
+    extra = vllm_config.additional_config
+    backend = extra.get("decode_backend", "auto") if isinstance(extra, dict) else "auto"
+    if backend == "auto":
+        return False
+    if backend != "latency_specialized":
+        raise ValueError("Supported decode_backend values are auto/latency_specialized")
+    from vllm.models.minimax_m3.nvidia.ops.finalize_allreduce_norm import (
+        supports_fused_moe_finalize,
+    )
+
+    missing = unsupported(vllm_config)
+    if not supports_fused_moe_finalize(vllm_config):
+        missing.append(
+            "tensor parallelism with the fused MoE finalize + all-reduce + norm "
+            "(NVLink multicast on every rank)"
+        )
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"decode_backend=latency_specialized needs {'; '.join(missing)}."
+        )
+    logger.info_once(
+        "MiniMax-M3 specialized decode on: MoE layers that leave their finalize "
+        "to the next layer run the low-batch FFN in FULL-graph decode steps of "
+        "1-8 rows."
+    )
+    return True

+
+From the post-attention norm's output to the ``MoEOutput`` the fused
+finalize + all-reduce + norm kernel (``ops/finalize_allreduce_norm.py``)
+takes, the stock chain runs about eleven small kernels. Here::
+
+    x ─► gate (stock) ─► front ─► FC1 ─► FC2 input ─► FC2 ─► gemm2_permuted
+    │                    (top-4, NVFP4 x, record)
+    └─(aux stream)─► MXFP8 x ─► FC1 (split K) ─► SwiGLU, MXFP8 h ─► FC2
+                                                         └─► shared_output
+
+* ``front_cute.py``: the routing (top-4 of ``sigmoid(logit) + bias``, the
+  weights from the recovered scores), the routed input's per-token NVFP4 and
+  the routing record of ``routed_expert_route_cute.py`` in one launch, and the
+  per-token NVFP4 of FC1's BF16 output;
+* ``gemm_cute.py``: FC1 (with SwiGLU-OAI) and FC2, persistent ``tcgen05``
+  NVFP4 GEMMs over the record's (weight tile, token tile) items;
+* ``shared_cute.py``: the MXFP8 shared expert on the same GEMM.
+
+The kernels read the weights vLLM prepares for the TRT-LLM-gen NVFP4 experts

+  policy computes it) and the weights ``scale * s_k / (sum(s) + 1e-20)`` in
+  BF16; then the whole CTA builds the routing record
+  (``routed_expert_route_cute.py``) from the selected ids;
+* CTA ``1 + r``: row ``r`` of the BF16 input to per-token NVFP4, eight values
+  per thread.
+
+:class:`Fc2InputQuant` quantizes the BF16 ``h`` rows FC1 wrote, one CTA per
+8-row token tile of the record, eight values per thread.
+
+Both quantize per token as the stock activation quantization does (its fast
+path): ``pt = amax(|row|) * (1 / 2688)``, ``encode = rcp(pt)``; per 16-value
+block ``sf = e4m3(encode * (amax(block) * rcp(6)))``, ``out = rcp(f32(sf) *
+rcp(encode))``, ``code = e2m1(value * out)`` (``rcp`` is ``rcp.approx.ftz``,
+conversions round to nearest and saturate). The GEMMs dequantize with
+``pt``. The input's scales are stored linearly ([rows, 384]); ``h``'s in the
+128x4 atom layout FC2 loads with TMA (one 128-row atom per 8-row tile, rows
+0-7 used).
+
+PDL: both trigger their dependents on entry; every read of a previous
+kernel's output follows the grid-dependency wait (the routing bias, a weight,
+is read before it).
+"""

+
+def _asm(result, operands: list, text: str, constraints: str, loc, ip):
+    """A side-effect-free PTX inline assembly operation."""
+    return llvm.inline_asm(
+        result,
+        operands,
+        text,
+        constraints,
+        has_side_effects=False,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+def _f32(value, loc, ip):
+    return Float32(value).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+
+
+def _u32(value, loc, ip):
+    return Uint32(value).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+
+
+# ---- per-token NVFP4
+
+# Eight BF16 values ($2-$5) of a block with amax $6, under encode scale $7:
+# the eight E2M1 codes ($0, value 0 in the low nibble) and the block's E4M3
+# scale byte ($1).
+_QUANTIZE_X8 = """{
+.reg .pred p;
+.reg .b16 sb, s_lo, s_hi;
+.reg .b32 sw, w;
+.reg .f32 r6, sf, sv, ie, os, a, b;
+.reg .b8 q0, q1, q2, q3;
+rcp.approx.ftz.f32 r6, 0f40C00000;
+mul.f32 sf, $6, r6;
+mul.f32 sf, $7, sf;
+cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 sb, 0f00000000, sf;
+cvt.rn.f16x2.e4m3x2 sw, sb;
+mov.b32 {s_lo, s_hi}, sw;
+cvt.f32.f16 sv, s_lo;
+rcp.approx.ftz.f32 ie, $7;
+mul.f32 sv, sv, ie;
+rcp.approx.ftz.f32 os, sv;
+setp.ne.f32 p, $6, 0f00000000;
+selp.f32 os, os, 0f00000000, p;
+shl.b32 w, $2, 16;
+mov.b32 a, w;
+and.b32 w, $2, 0xFFFF0000;
+mov.b32 b, w;
+mul.f32 a, a, os;
+mul.f32 b, b, os;
+cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2.f32 q0, b, a;
+shl.b32 w, $3, 16;
+mov.b32 a, w;
+and.b32 w, $3, 0xFFFF0000;
+mov.b32 b, w;
+mul.f32 a, a, os;
+mul.f32 b, b, os;
+cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2.f32 q1, b, a;
+shl.b32 w, $4, 16;
+mov.b32 a, w;
+and.b32 w, $4, 0xFFFF0000;
+mov.b32 b, w;
+mul.f32 a, a, os;
+mul.f32 b, b, os;
+cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2.f32 q2, b, a;
+shl.b32 w, $5, 16;
+mov.b32 a, w;
+and.b32 w, $5, 0xFFFF0000;
+mov.b32 b, w;
+mul.f32 a, a, os;
+mul.f32 b, b, os;
+cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2.f32 q3, b, a;
+mov.b32 $0, {q0, q1, q2, q3};
+cvt.u32.u16 $1, sb;
+}"""
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def quantize_x8(words, block_amax, encode, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """Eight BF16 values (four words) of one block to E2M1 codes and the
+    block's E4M3 scale (module docstring)."""
+    result = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32(), T.i32()]),
+        [_u32(words[i], loc, ip) for i in range(4)]
+        + [_f32(block_amax, loc, ip), _f32(encode, loc, ip)],
+        _QUANTIZE_X8,
+        "=r,=r,r,r,r,r,f,f",
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return (
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), result, [0], loc=loc, ip=ip)),
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), result, [1], loc=loc, ip=ip)),
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def per_token_scales(amax, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """``pt = amax / 2688`` and ``encode = rcp(pt)`` (0 for a zero row)."""
+    result = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.f32(), T.f32()]),
+        [_f32(amax, loc, ip)],
+        "{\n.reg .pred p;\n.reg .f32 e;\nmul.f32 $0, $2, 0f39C30C31;\n"
+        "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 e, $0;\nsetp.ne.f32 p, $0, 0f00000000;\n"
+        "selp.f32 $1, e, 0f00000000, p;\n}",
+        "=f,=f,f",
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return (
+        Float32(llvm.extractvalue(T.f32(), result, [0], loc=loc, ip=ip)),
+        Float32(llvm.extractvalue(T.f32(), result, [1], loc=loc, ip=ip)),
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def local_amax(words) -> Float32:
+    """Amax of eight BF16 values."""
+    pair = max_bf16x2(
+        abs_max_bf16x2(words[0], words[1]), abs_max_bf16x2(words[2], words[3])
+    )
+    return bf16x2_max_to_f32(pair)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def warp_max(value: Float32) -> Float32:
+    for shift in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        value = max_f32(value, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(value, 1 << shift))
+    return value
+

+# ---- routing
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def sigmoid_biased(logit, bias, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """``biased = 1 / (1 + exp(-logit)) + bias`` and its selection key (an
+    order-preserving unsigned key, larger value, larger key)."""
+    e = cute.math.exp(-Float32(logit), fastmath=False)
+    result = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.f32(), T.i32()]),
+        [_f32(e, loc, ip), _f32(bias, loc, ip)],
+        "{\n.reg .pred p;\n.reg .f32 d;\n.reg .b32 b, n;\n"
+        "add.f32 d, $2, 0f3F800000;\nrcp.rn.f32 d, d;\nadd.f32 $0, d, $3;\n"
+        "mov.b32 b, $0;\nsetp.lt.s32 p, b, 0;\nnot.b32 n, b;\n"
+        "or.b32 b, b, 0x80000000;\nselp.b32 $1, n, b, p;\n}",
+        "=f,=r,f,f",
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return (
+        Float32(llvm.extractvalue(T.f32(), result, [0], loc=loc, ip=ip)),
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), result, [1], loc=loc, ip=ip)),
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def sub_f32(a, b, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    operands = [_f32(a, loc, ip), _f32(b, loc, ip)]
+    return Float32(_asm(T.f32(), operands, "sub.f32 $0, $1, $2;", "=f,f,f", loc, ip))
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def routing_weight(score, scale, total, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    """``score * scale / (total + 1e-20)``, round to nearest."""
+    return Float32(
+        _asm(
+            T.f32(),
+            [_f32(score, loc, ip), _f32(scale, loc, ip), _f32(total, loc, ip)],
+            "{\n.reg .f32 n, d;\nmul.f32 n, $1, $2;\nadd.f32 d, $3, 0f1E3CE508;\n"
+            "div.rn.f32 $0, n, d;\n}",
+            "=f,f,f,f",
+            loc,
+            ip,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def lane_best(key: cute.Tensor):
+    """The lane's best remaining entry: the largest key, then the lowest j."""
+    best_key = Uint32(key[0])
+    best_j = Int32(0)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, PER_LANE):
+        if Uint32(key[j]) > best_key:
+            best_key = Uint32(key[j])
+            best_j = Int32(j)
+    return best_key, best_j
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def select_row(logit: cute.Tensor, bias: cute.Tensor, lane: Int32):
+    """The top-4 of one row (expert = lane + 32 j), in selection order: each
+    round takes the warp's largest key with one ``redux.sync`` max, then the
+    lowest expert id holding it with one min; only the winning lane rescans.
+    Lane ``k < 4`` gets slot ``k``: its expert and recovered score."""
+    biased = cute.make_rmem_tensor((PER_LANE,), Float32)
+    key = cute.make_rmem_tensor((PER_LANE,), Uint32)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(PER_LANE):
+        biased[j], key[j] = sigmoid_biased(logit[j], bias[j])
+    best_key, best_j = lane_best(key)
+    out_id = Int32(-1)
+    out_score = Float32(0.0)
+    for slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(TOP_K):
+        top = Uint32(cute.arch.warp_redux_sync(best_key, "umax"))
+        mine = Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF)
+        if best_key == top:
+            mine = Uint32(lane + 32 * best_j)
+        winner = Int32(cute.arch.warp_redux_sync(mine, "umin"))
+        won = Float32(0.0)
+        if winner == lane + 32 * best_j:
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(PER_LANE):
+                if best_j == j:
+                    won = sub_f32(biased[j], bias[j])
+                    key[j] = Uint32(0)  # below every value's key
+            best_key, best_j = lane_best(key)
+        score = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(won, winner & 31)
+        if lane == slot:
+            out_id = winner
+            out_score = score
+    return out_id, out_score
+
+
+class LowBatchFront:
+    """Routing, routing record and per-token NVFP4 input (module docstring)."""
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        logits_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        bias_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        scale: Float32,
+        x_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        weights_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        x_quant_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        x_scale_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        x_pt_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        permuted_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        record_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """``logits``: FP32 [rows, 128]; ``bias``: FP32 [128]; ``x``: BF16
+        [rows, 6144] as words; outputs: ``weights`` BF16 bits [rows, 4] (as
+        Uint16), ``x_quant`` [rows, 3072] packed E2M1 as words, ``x_scale``
+        [rows, 384] E4M3, ``x_pt`` FP32 [rows], ``permuted`` int32 [rows, 4]
+        and the record. rows in [1, 8]."""
+        slots = cute.make_layout(rows * TOP_K)
+        self.kernel(
+            cute.make_tensor(logits_ptr, cute.make_layout(rows * EXPERTS)),
+            cute.make_tensor(bias_ptr, cute.make_layout(EXPERTS)),
+            scale,
+            cute.make_tensor(x_ptr, cute.make_layout(rows * HIDDEN // 2)),
+            cute.make_tensor(weights_ptr, slots),
+            cute.make_tensor(x_quant_ptr, cute.make_layout(rows * HIDDEN // 8)),
+            cute.make_tensor(x_scale_ptr, cute.make_layout(rows * HIDDEN // SF_VEC)),
+            cute.make_tensor(x_pt_ptr, cute.make_layout(rows)),
+            cute.make_tensor(permuted_ptr, slots),
+            cute.make_tensor(
+                record_ptr, cute.make_layout(record_words(rows, TOP_K, EXPERTS))
+            ),
+            rows,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(1 + rows, 1, 1), block=[THREADS, 1, 1], stream=stream, use_pdl=True
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        logits: cute.Tensor,
+        bias: cute.Tensor,
+        scale: Float32,
+        x: cute.Tensor,
+        weights: cute.Tensor,
+        x_quant: cute.Tensor,
+        x_scale: cute.Tensor,
+        x_pt: cute.Tensor,
+        permuted: cute.Tensor,
+        record: cute.Tensor,
+        rows: Int32,
+    ):
+        """CTA 0 routes; CTA ``1 + r`` quantizes row ``r``."""
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        thread, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        cta, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+
+        @cute.struct
+        class Shared:
+            present: cute.struct.MemRange[Uint32, WORDS]
+            rows_of: cute.struct.MemRange[Uint32, MAX_EXPERTS]
+            ids: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, MAX_ROWS * TOP_K]
+            warp_amax: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, THREADS // 32]
+
+        shared = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator().allocate(Shared)
+        present = _view(shared.present, WORDS)
+        rows_of = _view(shared.rows_of, MAX_EXPERTS)
+        ids = _view(shared.ids, MAX_ROWS * TOP_K)
+        warp_amax = _view(shared.warp_amax, THREADS // 32)
+        if cta != 0:
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            quantize_row(x, cta - 1, thread, x_quant, x_scale, x_pt, warp_amax, HIDDEN)
+        else:
+            clear_scratch(present, rows_of, thread, THREADS)
+            row_bias = cute.make_rmem_tensor((PER_LANE,), Float32)
+            if thread // 32 < rows:
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(PER_LANE):
+                    row_bias[j] = bias[thread % 32 + 32 * j]
+            cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            zero_record(record, rows, TOP_K, EXPERTS, thread, THREADS)
+            if thread // 32 < rows:
+                route_row(logits, row_bias, scale, weights, ids, thread)
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            build_record(
+                present,
+                rows_of,
+                ids,
+                permuted,
+                record,
+                rows,
+                Int32(TOP_K),
+                Int32(EXPERTS),
+                thread,
+            )
+
+
+def _view(member, size: int) -> cute.Tensor:
+    return cute.make_tensor(member.data_ptr(), cute.make_layout(size))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def route_row(
+    logits: cute.Tensor,
+    bias: cute.Tensor,
+    scale: Float32,
+    weights: cute.Tensor,
+    ids: cute.Tensor,
+    thread: Int32,
+):
+    """Warp ``w``: the top-4 and BF16 weights of row ``w``, the ids also to
+    shared memory for the routing record."""
+    row = thread // 32
+    lane = thread % 32
+    logit = cute.make_rmem_tensor((PER_LANE,), Float32)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(PER_LANE):
+        logit[j] = logits[row * EXPERTS + lane + 32 * j]
+    expert, score = select_row(logit, bias, lane)
+    total = score
+    if lane >= TOP_K:
+        total = Float32(0.0)
+    for shift in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+        total = add_f32(total, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(total, 1 << shift))
+    weight = cutlass.Uint16(f32_to_bf16_bits(routing_weight(score, scale, total)))
+    if lane < TOP_K:
+        weights[row * TOP_K + lane] = weight
+        ids[row * TOP_K + lane] = expert
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def quantize_row(
+    values: cute.Tensor,
+    row: Int32,
+    thread: Int32,
+    codes_out: cute.Tensor,
+    scales_out: cute.Tensor,
+    pt_out: cute.Tensor,
+    warp_amax: cute.Tensor,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """Per-token NVFP4 of BF16 row ``row`` (``values`` as words) by a CTA of
+    ``width / 8`` threads; linear scales."""
+    words = load_global_u32x4(values.iterator + row * (width // 2) + thread * 4)
+    amax = local_amax(words)
+    row_amax = warp_max(amax)
+    if cute.arch.lane_idx() == 0:
+        warp_amax[thread // 32] = row_amax
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+    row_amax = Float32(warp_amax[0])
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, width // 8 // 32):
+        row_amax = max_f32(row_amax, warp_amax[w])
+    pt, encode = per_token_scales(row_amax)
+    block_amax = max_f32(amax, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(amax, 1))
+    codes, sf = quantize_x8(words, block_amax, encode)
+    codes_out[row * (width // 8) + thread] = codes
+    if thread % 2 == 0:
+        scales_out[row * (width // SF_VEC) + thread // 2] = Uint8(sf)
+    if thread == 0:
+        pt_out[row] = pt
+

+class Fc2InputQuant:
+    """Per-token NVFP4 of FC1's BF16 ``h`` rows, one CTA per token tile of
+    the record (module docstring)."""
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        h_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        record_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        h_quant_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        h_scale_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        h_pt_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        tiles: Int32,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """``h``: BF16 [8 tiles, 768] as words; outputs ``h_quant`` [8 tiles,
+        384] packed E2M1 as words, ``h_scale`` (one 6144-byte atom block per
+        tile) and ``h_pt`` FP32 [8 tiles]; ``tiles``: the record's capacity."""
+        h_rows = tiles * TILE
+        self.kernel(
+            cute.make_tensor(h_ptr, cute.make_layout(h_rows * INTERMEDIATE // 2)),
+            cute.make_tensor(record_ptr, cute.make_layout(4 + 2 * cta_words)),
+            cute.make_tensor(h_quant_ptr, cute.make_layout(h_rows * INTERMEDIATE // 8)),
+            cute.make_tensor(h_scale_ptr, cute.make_layout(tiles * H_TILE_BYTES)),
+            cute.make_tensor(h_pt_ptr, cute.make_layout(h_rows)),
+            cta_words,
+        ).launch(grid=(tiles, 1, 1), block=[THREADS, 1, 1], stream=stream, use_pdl=True)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        h: cute.Tensor,
+        record: cute.Tensor,
+        h_quant: cute.Tensor,
+        h_scale: cute.Tensor,
+        h_pt: cute.Tensor,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Thread ``t`` of a tile: row ``t / 96`` of the tile, values
+        ``8 (t % 96) ..`` of it."""
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+
+        @cute.struct
+        class Shared:
+            warp_amax: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, THREADS // 32]
+
+        shared = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator().allocate(Shared)
+        warp_amax = _view(shared.warp_amax, THREADS // 32)
+        thread, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        tile, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        if tile < record[1]:
+            quantize_tile(
+                h,
+                tile,
+                thread,
+                record[4 + cta_words + tile],
+                h_quant,
+                h_scale,
+                h_pt,
+                warp_amax,
+            )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def quantize_tile(
+    h: cute.Tensor,
+    tile: Int32,
+    thread: Int32,
+    limit: Int32,
+    h_quant: cute.Tensor,
+    h_scale: cute.Tensor,
+    h_pt: cute.Tensor,
+    warp_amax: cute.Tensor,
+):
+    """Per-token NVFP4 of the rows of ``tile`` below ``limit``: thread ``t``
+    takes row ``t / 96`` of the tile, values ``8 (t % 96) ..`` of it; scales
+    in the 128x4 atom layout (module docstring). Rows past the limit hold no
+    FC1 output and are read as zero, not stored."""
+    r = thread // H_THREADS
+    t = thread - r * H_THREADS
+    row = tile * TILE + r
+    keep = Uint32(0) - Uint32(row < limit)
+    loaded = load_global_u32x4(h.iterator + row * (INTERMEDIATE // 2) + t * 4)
+    words = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4,), Uint32)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        words[i] = loaded[i] & keep

+
+    def __init__(self, cta_k: int = 256, num_ab_stage: int = 6) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            2 * INTERMEDIATE, 2 * INTERMEDIATE // 128, SPLIT_K, cta_k, num_ab_stage
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        a_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sfa_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        b_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sfb_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        out_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        route_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        ctas: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """A: w_gate_up (1536, 6144) E4M3, K-major, E8M0 scales in the 128x4
+        layout; B: the quantized input (96, 512), tile ``s`` K split ``s``;
+        out FP32."""
+        self.a_dtype = a_ptr.value_type
+        self.b_dtype = b_ptr.value_type
+        self.sf_dtype = sfa_ptr.value_type
+        m = self.m
+        a = cute.make_tensor(
+            a_ptr,
+            cute.make_layout((m, SPLIT_K, SPLITS), stride=(HIDDEN, 1, SPLIT_K)),
+        )
+        # The 128x4 layout of (m, HIDDEN) with K split: atoms of 4 scales
+        # (128 columns) are 512 bytes apart, row tiles HIDDEN / 128 atoms.
+        atoms = SPLIT_K // (4 * SF_VEC)
+        sfa = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfa_ptr,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                ((32, 4, m // 128), (SF_VEC, 4, atoms), SPLITS),
+                stride=(
+                    (16, 4, HIDDEN // (4 * SF_VEC) * ATOM_BYTES),
+                    (0, 1, ATOM_BYTES),
+                    atoms * ATOM_BYTES,
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+        b = cute.make_tensor(
+            b_ptr,
+            cute.make_ordered_layout((SPLITS * TILE, SPLIT_K, 1), order=(1, 0, 2)),
+        )
+        sfb = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfb_ptr,
+            blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(
+                cute.make_ordered_layout(
+                    (SPLITS * 128, SPLIT_K, 1), order=(1, 0, 2)
+                ).shape,
+                SF_VEC,
+            ),
+        )
+        out = cute.make_tensor(out_ptr, cute.make_layout(SPLITS * TILE * m))
+        route = cute.make_tensor(route_ptr, cute.make_layout(4 + 2 * cta_words))
+        self._launch(a, sfa, b, sfb, route, (out,), (), cta_words, ctas, stream)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def store(
+        self,
+        tDrAcc: cute.Tensor,
+        tDcC: cute.Tensor,
+        epi: tuple,
+        mRoute: cute.Tensor,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        n_tile: Int32,
+        m_tile: Int32,
+        item: Int32,
+        exchange: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        """The FP32 partial sums, at [split * 8 + row, weight row]."""
+        (mOut,) = epi
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(tDrAcc)):
+            coord = tDcC[i]
+            mOut[coord[1] * self.m + coord[0]] = tDrAcc[i]
+
+
+class SharedAct:
+    """Split sums, BF16 gate_up, SwiGLU-OAI and MXFP8 of ``h`` (module
+    docstring), one CTA of 96 threads per row, eight columns of ``h`` per
+    thread."""
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        partial_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        quant_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        scale_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """``partial``: FP32 [SPLITS, 8, 1536]; ``quant``: E4M3 [8, 768] as
+        words; ``scale``: one tile of atoms."""
+        self.kernel(
+            cute.make_tensor(
+                partial_ptr, cute.make_layout(SPLITS * TILE * 2 * INTERMEDIATE)
+            ),
+            cute.make_tensor(quant_ptr, cute.make_layout(TILE * INTERMEDIATE // 4)),
+            cute.make_tensor(
+                scale_ptr, cute.make_layout(tile_scale_bytes(INTERMEDIATE))
+            ),
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(rows, 1, 1),
+            block=[INTERMEDIATE // 8, 1, 1],
+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=True,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(self, partial: cute.Tensor, quant: cute.Tensor, scales: cute.Tensor):
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        thread, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        row, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        first = thread * 8
+        gate = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Float32)
+        up = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Float32)
+        gate.fill(0.0)
+        up.fill(0.0)
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        for split in cutlass.range_constexpr(SPLITS):
+            base = (split * TILE + row) * 2 * INTERMEDIATE + first
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                gate[i] = gate[i] + partial[base + i]
+                up[i] = up[i] + partial[base + INTERMEDIATE + i]
+        # gate_up as the stock GEMM stores it, then h in BF16.
+        words = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4,), Uint32)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            words[i] = swiglu_oai_bf16x2(
+                _bf16_round(up[2 * i]),
+                _bf16_round(gate[2 * i]),
+                Float32(1.0),
+                _bf16_round(up[2 * i + 1]),
+                _bf16_round(gate[2 * i + 1]),
+            )
+        store_mxfp8(quant, scales, words, row, first, INTERMEDIATE)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _bf16_round(value: Float32) -> Float32:
+    """``value`` rounded to BF16 (nearest even), as FP32."""
+    return Float32(cutlass.BFloat16(value))
+
+
+class SharedFc2(RoutedExpertGemm):
+    """down: BF16 ``h @ w_down^T`` (module docstring), rows below the
+    record's limit stored."""
+
+    def __init__(self, cta_k: int = 256, num_ab_stage: int = 6) -> None:
+        super().__init__(HIDDEN, HIDDEN // 128, INTERMEDIATE, cta_k, num_ab_stage)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        a_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sfa_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        b_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sfb_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        out_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        route_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        ctas: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """A: w_down (6144, 768) E4M3, K-major, E8M0 scales in the 128x4
+        layout; B: the quantized ``h`` (8, 768); out: BF16 [rows, 6144]."""
+        self.a_dtype = a_ptr.value_type
+        self.b_dtype = b_ptr.value_type
+        self.sf_dtype = sfa_ptr.value_type
+        a = cute.make_tensor(
+            a_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((self.m, self.k, 1), order=(1, 0, 2))
+        )
+        sfa = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfa_ptr, blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(a.shape, SF_VEC)
+        )
+        b = cute.make_tensor(
+            b_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((TILE, self.k, 1), order=(1, 0, 2))
+        )
+        sfb = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfb_ptr,
+            blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(
+                cute.make_ordered_layout((128, self.k, 1), order=(1, 0, 2)).shape,
+                SF_VEC,
+            ),
+        )
+        out = cute.make_tensor(
+            out_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((self.m, rows), order=(0, 1))
+        )
+        route = cute.make_tensor(route_ptr, cute.make_layout(4 + 2 * cta_words))
+        self._launch(a, sfa, b, sfb, route, (out,), (), cta_words, ctas, stream)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def store(
+        self,
+        tDrAcc: cute.Tensor,
+        tDcC: cute.Tensor,
+        epi: tuple,
+        mRoute: cute.Tensor,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        n_tile: Int32,
+        m_tile: Int32,
+        item: Int32,
+        exchange: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        """Round to BF16 (nearest even) and store the rows below the limit."""
+        (mOut,) = epi
+        row_limit = mRoute[4 + cta_words + n_tile]
+        tDrC = cute.make_rmem_tensor(tDrAcc.shape, cutlass.BFloat16)
+        tDrC.store(tDrAcc.load().to(cutlass.BFloat16))
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(tDrC)):
+            coord = tDcC[i]
+            if coord[1] < row_limit:
+                mOut[coord[0], coord[1]] = tDrC[i]
